items.title: Nasa tells ISS astronauts to shelter during air leak repair attempt
items.description: Russian attempt to repair tunnel area sparks safe-haven procedure for five other astronauts onboard.

items.title: Ukraine strikes cargo ships and admits Romania drone blast
items.description: Ukraine says it struck five ships carrying illegal cargo in the Sea of Azov and in coastal waters of Russian-occupied territories.

items.title: Zelensky proposes face-to-face talks in open letter to Putin
items.description: Ukraine's president tells the Russian leader that only "direct engagement" between the two countries could end the war, with the US focused on Iran.

items.title: Fury in France after child murder suspect's criminal record released
items.description: A man suspected of murdering an 11-year-old girl had previously been identified as a potential child molester, records show.

items.title: Nearly 50 people die of thirst in Sahara desert after lorry breaks down
items.description: Only two survived after trekking more than 50km (30 miles) across the desert to alert the authorities.

items.title: US actor James Handy stabbed to death, with girlfriend's son arrested
items.description: Handy, 81, is known for his roles in films including Jumanji and Top Gun: Maverick.

items.title: Three jailed over heist of ancient golden helmet from Dutch museum
items.description: The men are sentenced to 47 months each for stealing the 2,500-year-old Romanian Coțofenești helmet.

items.title: Everest guide survived six-day ordeal by eating chocolate and 'chewing ice'
items.description: Dawa Sherpa was spotted alive by a cleaning crew as he slid slowly down the world's tallest mountain and spoke to the BBC from hospital.

items.title: Ex-wife of Dubai ruler's nephew in custody, prosecutors say
items.description: Zeynab Javadli had not been in contact with any of her friends since Tuesday.

items.title: US journalist pleads guilty to working as China's agent
items.description: Thomas Weir Pauken II, 50, knowingly worked with people employed by the Chinese government for years.

items.title: Xi Jinping to meet Kim Jong Un in rare visit to North Korea
items.description: It is taking place weeks after Xi met the leaders of the US and Russia - two countries that loom large over North Korea's foreign policy.

items.title: Hospitality jobs boom as US prepares for World Cup
items.description: It is the third month in a row US jobs figures have beaten expectations.
